narration_timeline.text: What does a common blackbird do when the park is quiet?
narration_timeline.scene: Blackbird perched on a snowy branch in a city park.

narration_timeline.text: It explores short grass and the edges of paths, pausing to inspect the ground.
narration_timeline.scene: Blackbird on park lawn or path.

narration_timeline.text: In a botanical garden, even small patches of soil and leaves can attract a searching bird.
narration_timeline.scene: Blackbirds in two distinct botanical garden scenes.

narration_timeline.text: A few steps take it from open ground toward the grass, where it can pause and watch.
narration_timeline.scene: Blackbirds walking and pausing in open ground and grassy park vegetation; no disappearing claim.

narration_timeline.text: In dense branches, its rounded body and dark feathers can be harder to spot.
narration_timeline.scene: Blackbird partly hidden among berry-laden branches.

narration_timeline.text: Here it pauses again, looking over another patch of the park for its next bite.
narration_timeline.scene: Blackbird turning and pausing in a different grassy patch.
